HOG_2018_p5__paragraph_4.ocr:
Parts & Accessories (P&A) and General Merchandise – The Company offers a complete line of Harley-Davidson P&A and General Merchandise. P&A
products are comprised of replacement parts (Genuine Motor Parts) and mechanical and cosmetic accessories (Genuine Motor Accessories). General
Merchandise includes MotorClothes® apparel and riding gear. Licensing – The Company creates an awareness of the Harley-Davidson brand among its customers and the non-riding public by licensing the name
“Harley-Davidson” and other trademarks owned by the Company for use on a wide range of products for enthusiasts and others.
